setup: The Gudermannian angle gd(u) is defined so that tan(gd u) = sinh u, and this instance supplies the value [[x]].

steps.say: By definition the tangent of the Gudermannian angle is the hyperbolic sine of the argument, so the two agree at every value.
The explicit form gd(u) = 2 arctan(e^u) - pi/2 turns that relation into an angle in radians, and radians are converted to degrees when degrees are asked for.
Using [[x]] as the quantity the question supplies and rounding to the nearest unit gives the requested value.
